About.title: About
About.body: Product-oriented software engineer with experience taking end-to-end web applications from requirements and technical design through integration and production. I build maintainable solutions with <highlight>TypeScript, React, Next.js, and APIs</highlight>, focusing on architecture, payments, performance, and reliable delivery.

highlights.1: End-to-end design and development of web applications and modules with Next.js, React, and TypeScript, from requirements and technical solution through integration and production release.
highlights.2: Designed and implemented payment and subscription flows with Stripe and NMI, connecting checkout, backend, and transaction states in production.
highlights.3: Designed and evolved frontend architecture: application structure, reusable components, state management, data access, and API integration patterns.
highlights.4: Optimized loading, rendering, and technical SEO to improve performance and user experience; automated CI/CD pipelines and deployments on Vercel.

highlights.1: Developed business applications and modules with React, Vite, and TypeScript, turning functional requirements into maintainable flows and interfaces.
highlights.2: Integrated REST APIs and backend services, implementing data handling, validations, loading and error states, and business operations.
highlights.3: Refactored components and reusable logic to reduce duplication and make it easier to add new features.
